title: Infrastructure
desc: Build system, CI, workspace plumbing. Norm inherited from the rewrite plan (git history has it): one PR per work item; every PR leaves the repo working and CI green.

title: Scaffold
desc: Shipped as PR #56 (squash ee09573). flake + npins (kolu@4d8a668, nixpkgs), Bun, drishti-style workspace, bunfig.toml isolated linker, @kolu/* hydrate + check-kolu-deps scripts, justfile whose `check` recipe IS the CI DAG ([metadata("ci")], odu-only — the planned GHA wrapper was dropped mid-flight at the human's direction), linux + darwin lanes, bun2nix from juspay/bun2nix#2. Effect wired in from day one: effect + @effect/platform-node at the kolu pin's exact version (4.0.0-beta.106) with single-copy overrides, and packages/core shipped a real @kolu/surface + Effect Schema cell exercised by bun test — that package is gone as of see-outline (PR #58), which split it into format/store/surface/server/web.

title: Viewing
desc: Seeing your outlines in the browser, kept current with what is on disk.

title: See your outline
desc:
Shipped as PR #58 (squash ac0cba3). Serve a directory, parse and validate the .jsonl files (format core: unique ids, dangling refs, cycles, stored derived state), render the tree read-only in the browser via a minimal surface view. Visible: your outline in a browser tab — or the validation error, with file:line.
Resolved 2026-08-09: entrypoint is `olai web <dir> [--port] [--host]` (nix-built binary; just serve and nix run wrap it; loopback default); UI is a sidebar of found outlines + one tree per route; mirrors render the target subtree inline, marked (cycle-safe); nodes render title with styled #tags, derived done/doing/open status, date badge, and desc as sanitized markdown; packages/store is born here in load-once form (revision-tagged snapshot, codec seam; watcher/probe arrive with live-updates — see docs/brainstorming/architecture.live-store.md); an invalid set renders an error view listing ALL errors with file:line, grouped by file, cross-file errors in their own section; the tree has client-local collapse/expand; e2e is Cucumber + Playwright in kolu's packages/tests shape, features written fresh for this item (nothing ported from the racket branch); styling is Tailwind v4 exactly as kolu does it (utilities inline; no class-validity scanner — accepted trade-off, decided 2026-08-09). Specs: docs/format.md, docs/architecture.md.

title: Live updates
desc:
Probe-based staleness over the recursive directory, snapshot stream, error cell. Visible: edit a file or git pull, the page updates without reload; break a file, its outline degrades in place while the rest stays live; a cross-file break keeps last-good and shows the error banner.
Resolved 2026-08-09: error scope is hybrid — a file that fails to decode renders its error in place of that one outline (emanote-style) while other outlines stay live; cross-file validation failures (dangling refs, cycles) hold whole-set last-good with the banner (the codec passes decode failures into validate so the snapshot embeds per-outline failures; store stays generic); deletion is not special (a probe diff — dangling inbound refs are ordinary validation errors, no grace window); the commit()/optimistic-concurrency write gate is deferred to the chat item, where the ops layer is born; the periodic backstop probe stays (~60s) alongside the watcher and refresh(); stamps are mtime+size. This item also closes the see-outline test gap: packages/store gets real unit tests. Design: docs/brainstorming/architecture.live-store.md.

title: Zoom & navigation
desc: Zoom into any node as its own page at /n/<id> — stable set-unique ids make permalinks free, surviving renames and moves across files — with breadcrumbs that always show the canonical parent chain (stateless, even when you arrived through a mirror) and a per-view done-visibility toggle (client-local cell, like collapse). Resolved 2026-08-09 (see brainstorming doc). Depends only on see-outline's tree — can run in parallel with live-updates. Brainstorming: docs/brainstorming/viewing-web.md.

title: Search & filter
desc: Filter-in-place that keeps ancestors for context (Workflowy-style), including tag-click filtering (resolved 2026-08-09: it lands here, not with navigation), and an operator language over derived state (is:done, date:, has:desc). The operator language is a design of its own — brainstorm before dispatch. Brainstorming: docs/brainstorming/viewing-web.md.

title: Documents
desc: Render the served .md files as documents and link them from nodes' doc fields. Moved out of the old editor-growth bucket — it is viewing, not editing. Depends only on see-outline's reader; parallel-safe with everything else in this theme.

title: Agents
desc: Coding agents reading and editing outlines through olai.

title: Chat
desc:
One PR: the chat panel — an ACP session (@agentclientprotocol/sdk) projected into surface events; send, stream, cancel. The ops layer is born here (add, mark, move, archive; fractional-ord insertion; temp-file → re-validate → rename → commit) since chat's agent is the first writer; whole-file agent writes stay rejected. Visible: ask the agent in the web app to check something off and watch the outline update live; a refused write (derived state) shows its unfinished children in chat.
Decided 2026-08-09: the former agent-editing and chat items collapse into this one; MCP tools for external coding agents are punted to their own item. Resolved 2026-08-09: Claude first via a claude-code ACP adapter; the server owns one singleton ACP session (olai is single-user); agent→ops channel is an internal MCP server passed via session/new; ops tool calls auto-approved (permission UI deferred); agent reads via internal MCP query tools only (likely incl. grep), no fs; transcripts persist as Claude Code's own session for the served directory so `claude --resume` works from a terminal; errors are never silently ignored — only a succeeding StaleWrite retry is invisible, every genuine failure renders in chat with structured detail. Brainstorming: docs/brainstorming/acp.md.

title: MCP for external agents
desc: Punted 2026-08-09: expose the ops layer as MCP tools so a coding agent outside olai (e.g. in a terminal) can edit outlines. Chat's internal agent→ops wiring is expected to produce most of this for free.

title: Editor
desc: Editing outlines directly in the web UI. Everything goes through the same ops layer as the agent (born in chat); the growth items after keyboard-editing are mutually independent — parallel-safe, one PR each.

title: Keyboard editing
desc: The Workflowy loop without the agent, through the same ops procedures. Resolved 2026-08-09: structural actions (Enter adds a sibling, Tab/Shift+Tab indent/outdent, Alt+Shift+↑↓ move, Ctrl+Enter toggles done, delete) are immediate ops; text edits buffer in a client-local draft cell committed on blur/Enter/idle — no optimistic UI, the draft is an editor, not committed state; Shift+Enter opens the desc as a plain textarea (rendered markdown returns on blur); split/merge, undo, multi-select, drag-drop each deferred to their own items — git is the recovery net until undo lands. Open at dispatch: how the computed checkbox on a node with children reads, and the delete-without-undo affordance. Brainstorming: docs/brainstorming/editing-web.md.

title: Split & merge
desc: Enter mid-text splits a node in two; Backspace at line start merges into the previous sibling — compound ops over existing primitives (deferred 2026-08-09 out of keyboard-editing).

title: Undo
desc: Undo/redo for web edits (deferred 2026-08-09 out of keyboard-editing; git is the recovery net until then). Leading candidate: client-side op inverses — undo *my* last op, safe under concurrent editors.

title: Drag-drop & multi-select
desc: Drag a node to move it with its subtree; Workflowy's multi-select gestures with bulk complete/move/indent/delete. Research: docs/brainstorming/editing-web.md.

title: Input affordances
desc: The Workflowy input widgets: `!` date picker with natural language, `#`/`@` tag autocomplete, `((` mirror-creation search. Research: docs/brainstorming/editing-web.md.

title: Command palette
desc: Ctrl+K palette over ops and navigation — jump-to-node type-ahead and named shortcuts live here (Workflowy's Jump To).
